items.headline: State police detective charged with DUI on North Main Road
items.blurb: Jamestown police charged a Rhode Island State Police detective with suspicion of DUI and refusal to submit to a chemical test after a stop late Oct. 15 on North Main Road. He is presumed innocent; State Police called it an open personnel matter.

items.headline: Jamestown man arrested on reckless driving warrant
items.blurb: Rhode Island State Police arrested a 52-year-old Jamestown man at his Howland Avenue home on a reckless driving warrant. He was arraigned and released with a court date.
